reading.title: Meat & Seafood 1: A short reading
reading.text: Maya plans dinner for her family. She compares chicken, turkey, and duck at the shop, then chooses chicken breast. Omar asks the butcher about beef and lamb for a different meal. They check the labels and ask for separate packages. At home, they put the food in the refrigerator before preparing anything else.
